question:
**Select the most appropriate synonym of the given word.**

Mercy
solution:
The correct answer is option 3), i.e., 'Clemency.'

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of the given word:

 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Mercy
 
 
kindness that makes you forgive someone, usually someone that you have authority over. (दया)

 
 
 

 
• ​Let's look at the meanings of the other given options:
 
• 
 
 
 

 Word
 Meaning
 
 
 
 

 Legacy
 money or property that you receive from someone after they die; something that is a part of your history or that remains from an earlier time. (धन या संपत्ति जो आपको किसी के मरने के बाद मिलती है; परंपरा)
 
 

 Clarity
 the quality of being clear and easy to understand. (स्पष्ट और समझने में आसान होने की गुणवत्ता)
 
 

 Clemency
 kindness when giving a punishment. (दया)
 
 

 Plurality
 a large number of different types of something. (बड़ी संख्या में विभिन्न प्रकार की कोई चीज)
 
 
 
 

 

 
• Clearly, the word 'Clemency' is closest in meaning to the given word '**Mercy**.'
 
• Therefore, the correct synonym of the given word is option 3.
